workflow: A comparison workload repeatedly compares values drawn from several numeric representations.
On some 32-bit environments, one mixed comparison intermittently reaches an invalid memory location.
The invalid access terminates the process, while repeating the same workload may succeed.
summary: Intermittent invalid memory access during heterogeneous numeric comparison
decision_reason: The underlying failure workflow materially matches the existing cluster: heterogeneous numeric comparisons intermittently trigger an invalid memory access and process termination, independent of project-specific tests or implementation names.
